recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-12704; future cleanup of historical opt-in/opt-out labels or external HL7 Terminology content should be handled as a separate issue because the current Consent conformance model no longer depends on the inverted magic policyRule definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-12704 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent. It reported that the DSTU2 Consent policyRule magic values for opt-in and opt-out were logically inverted for the Consent record perspective, and accepted changing away from those semantics, including by using permit and deny as with exceptions.
initial_application: Git commit 687d10304fe8c9e42f5ff4e7ff3c322653b167f4 explicitly listed GF#12704 and flipped affected Consent examples so opt-in examples represented generally approved sharing and opt-out examples represented generally denied sharing.
additional_context: Consent is active in the current build. Later Published issue FHIR-13358 retired the old http://hl7.org/fhir/ConsentPolicy/opt-in and /opt-out magic URIs by moving policyRule to CodeableConcept, and later Published issue FHIR-32817 replaced policy/policyRule with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, policyText, and explicit Consent.decision permit/deny semantics. Related FHIR-27774 confirms later WG preference to say permit/deny instead of opt-in/opt-out for the base policy sentence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current authoritative source has no active Consent.policyRule element and no remaining old ConsentPolicy opt-in/out URI usage; current Consent definitions and examples express the base rule with permit/deny and preserve the applied FHIR-12704 interpretation.
